messages:
alex: @melissa quick sync — NovumHealth POC confirmed. They want 30 days, dedicated capacity for the demo week, and an order form + MSA/DPA signed before we spin resources. Need PR/PO guidance too. Who owns routing for e-sign?

jordan: Copy. I asked procurement if they can issue a PO after we send the order form (they usually need an approved SOW). Targeting PO by next Tue. Pricing: we quoted $12k/month for reserved capacity during POC, with a single-use POC credit applied. Is that acceptable to legal?

melissa: Thanks @alex @jordan. I started redlines on the MSA and attached DPA comments. Put the drive link here: https://drive.example.com/novum/msadpa_redlines (internal). Key asks: indemnity narrow, liability cap tweak, and audit scope limit.

melissa: Snippet I'm pushing back on:
```
Section 9.2 Liability Cap: "Supplier's aggregate liability shall not exceed the total Fees paid in the prior 12 months."
```
We propose: "aggregate liability limited to the greater of $250,000 or 2x the Fees paid in the prior 12 months."

kevin: From ops/SE: Novum will run in our Dedicated pool (EU region). They want private VPC peering during the POC. Security needs to confirm IP allowlist + cert exchange. That will add ~2 days to setup.

maya: FYI I'm on the security questionnaire. Two quick items: 1) They asked for encryption-at-rest certs and KMS provider — we use AES-256 and customers can bring KMS (AWS KMS/HSM). 2) For SOC2 evidence, we can provide the latest report but need to redact some internal ops emails.

alex: @melissa can Legal accept the proposed liability language? Also we need the signature order: account exec -> Novum legal -> exec sign. Anyone able to route Docusign envelope?

melissa: Liability language is reasonable, but legal wants the cap to be additive for claims arising from data breach carveouts. I'll add a short carveout for wilful misconduct.

melissa: Routing: Legal prefers DocuSign with sequential signing. Proposed sequence: 1) Jordan (sales rep) 2) Novum signatory 3) Redwood exec (VP Sales). If Procurement needs PO to be attached, add it as an envelope attachment.

jordan: I can start the envelope once redlines are final. Quick ask: can we disable auto-merge of PO into the invoice line so their AP can still reference PO#?

legal-bot: Reminder: Attachments must be scanned for PII. Auto-flagging enabled. See https://redwood.internal/docs/esign-guidelines

kevin: Ops note: if they require VPC peering we should hold the dedicated pool until PO is cleared. Otherwise we can demo on hosted with data scrubbed. Which do we want for timeline?

alex: Decision needed today — hosted scrubbed demo (faster) or private peering (preferred by Novum). Jordan — confirm with customer if a scrubbed demo is ok for initial week, then follow with private peering for production POC. I'll freeze redlines once Melissa confirms final language.

jordan: On it. I'll ask now and loop back within the hour. :thumbsup:

melissa: If Jordan confirms hosted demo, I'll accept the liability compromise and upload final MSA + order form. Then we'll route DocuSign sequentially.

maya: Security will prepare the minimal evidence bundle for compliance review so Legal can attach to the envelope if needed.

alex: Thanks all — keep messages short here so I can forward the thread to Novum. If Jordan confirms hosted demo, target E-sign envelope send by 1600 PT today.

jordan: Novum confirmed: hosted scrubbed demo is fine for first week. They want private peering if we extend. Sending go-ahead now.

melissa: Final MSA uploaded: https://drive.example.com/novum/final_MSA_redline_accepted.docx. I accepted the liability tweak and added the wilful-misconduct carveout.

melissa: Order form note: set term = 30 days, setup fee waived for POC, POC credit code: NOVUM-POC-50.

alex: Great. Jordan — please attach PO as envelope document and cc procurement@novum.com. I'll add VP Sales as final signer.

jordan: Done. Envelope created and sent: https://docusign.com/envelope/0x12345 (redwood-internal link). Marking this thread resolved once signed. :white_check_mark:

legal-bot: Envelope status: SENT -> Novum signer. If status changes to SIGNED, notify #sales immediately.

alex: Closing notes: Log the POC in Salesforce (opp 00987-NUV), tag as "POC:dedicated-fallback:hosted-demo" and set start date to tomorrow. Thanks everyone.
